verdict.rationale: Supabase CLI supports `supabase init`/`supabase start` to run the full stack locally via Docker Compose without any account, and this was verified keylessly at runtime (npx supabase --version worked with no login). Local dev supports migrations and version control, enabling offline/CI workflows. missing for 10: no explicit CI pipeline example/docs excerpt showing supabase start used inside a CI job, and no independent third-party corroboration of full offline parity with hosted engine.
